skill.name: shadcn
skill.description: Guides AI assistants through shadcn/ui projects, including component selection, CLI workflows, presets, theming, registry usage, and safe component updates.
skill.summary: Helps AI assistants build, update, and troubleshoot shadcn/ui projects with CLI and component guidance.
skill.author: shadcn

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code spans, component examples, relative documentation links, or public documentation URLs. Confirmed risk remains around unpinned shadcn CLI commands, including one automatic project-context command and workflows that can write project files. No evidence found for prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious hidden behavior.

remediation.suggestion: Avoid automatic npx shadcn@latest execution during skill loading. Ask before running it, or pin the package version and show the command.
Require explicit user approval before init, add, force, reinstall, or overwrite actions. Prefer dry-run and diff previews first.
Require the user to name the registry, inspect added files, and document dependency changes before installing community items.

content.value_statement: Building shadcn/ui interfaces requires current project context and strict component patterns. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through CLI workflows and UI rules.
actual_capabilities: Reads shadcn project context through the CLI info command, including aliases, framework, Tailwind version, and installed components.
Guides component selection for forms, overlays, charts, navigation, feedback, and layout needs.
Uses CLI search, docs, add, view, dry-run, and diff workflows for registry items.
Applies shadcn composition rules, semantic Tailwind tokens, icon rules, and form validation patterns.
Helps update components with dry-run and diff steps before overwrite decisions.
Explains presets, templates, MCP setup, and custom registry configuration.
limitations: Requires the shadcn CLI and a supported package runner for project-aware operations.
May recommend commands that download packages or write project files.
Does not replace manual review for third-party registry code or generated UI changes.
Needs current project configuration for accurate aliases, Tailwind version, base, style, and icon library.

use_cases.title: Build project-aware components
use_cases.description: Create forms, dialogs, dashboards, and navigation that follow the project shadcn settings.

use_cases.title: Update a component library safely
use_cases.description: Preview upstream component changes, compare diffs, and preserve local edits during updates.

use_cases.title: Inspect registry items before install
use_cases.description: Review files, dependencies, imports, and composition issues before adding third-party blocks.

prompt_templates.title: Add a component
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a shadcn/ui button and card to my React page. Use my project aliases and explain any CLI command before running it.

prompt_templates.title: Build a form
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a settings form with name, email, and notification controls. Use FieldGroup, Field, validation states, semantic colors, and gap spacing.

prompt_templates.title: Review a registry item
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this third-party registry item before installation. Show expected files, dependencies, import changes, and issues that need approval.

prompt_templates.title: Switch presets safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Switch this project to the radix-nova preset while preserving local component changes. Use dry-run and diff steps before any write.

output_examples.input: Create a profile edit dialog with avatar, fields, Save, and Cancel buttons.
output_examples.output: Provides a dialog approach using DialogTitle, AvatarFallback, proper button icons, project icon imports, and accessible form composition.

output_examples.input: Update the Button component while keeping local changes.
output_examples.output: Recommends dry-run and diff review, identifies affected files, preserves local edits, and asks before any overwrite step.

output_examples.input: Add a dashboard stat card block from a community registry.
output_examples.output: Checks the registry name, previews files, reviews imports and dependencies, then applies shadcn composition and styling rules.

best_practices: Run dry-run and diff before any component update that can overwrite local changes.
Use project context for aliases, framework, Tailwind version, base, style, and icon library.
Inspect third-party registry files after adding them and fix imports before continuing.
anti_patterns: Do not guess a registry when the user asks for an unspecified block.
Do not fetch raw component files manually when the CLI can inspect registry items.
Do not use overwrite, force, or reinstall flags without explicit user approval.

faq.question: Does this skill install shadcn/ui components?
faq.answer: It can guide installation through the shadcn CLI. It should explain project changes and use preview commands first.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it work without a components.json file?
faq.answer: It can explain setup, but project-specific guidance requires shadcn project context.

faq.question: Will it overwrite my local components?
faq.answer: It should use dry-run and diff first. Overwrite or reinstall steps require explicit approval.

faq.question: Can it use community registries?
faq.answer: Yes. The registry must be named by the user, and added files should be reviewed.

faq.question: Does it replace manual code review?
faq.answer: No. Review generated components, dependencies, and third-party registry code before production use.
